impl From<PrefName> for CString {
    fn from(value: PrefName) -> Self {
        match value {
            PrefName::Key => c"key",
            PrefName::Uid => c"uid",
            PrefName::Description => c"description",
            PrefName::Username => c"username",
            PrefName::AuthMethod => c"auth_method",
            PrefName::EwsUrl => c"ews_url",
        }
        .into()
    }
}
